# Third-party data and code

`18662495/` contains unchanged files from **Ivanov, Edouard; Georgieva, Hristina; Stepanov, Petr; Lopez, Marco; Kück, Stefan**, *Modelling detector response for accurate calibration of single-photon detectors under pulsed single-photon illumination*, version 1, Zenodo, [10.5281/zenodo.18662495](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18662495).

The retrieved Zenodo API metadata declares **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International**, [license terms](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). That license governs these third-party files; the repository's license does not replace it. Original files are unchanged. `record.json` is the retrieved public metadata; `manifest.json` is our download/hash inventory. Our analysis outside this directory is separate and is not endorsed by the source authors.

Retrieved 2026-10-10. All sixteen original MD5 checksums verified; SHA256 identities recorded for subsequent verification. See the source article [10.1140/epjqt/s40507-026-00540-9](https://doi.org/10.1140/epjqt/s40507-026-00540-9).

`3701333/` is a separate, unchanged three-file data subset from Pucher, Schneeweiss, Rauschenbeutel and Dareau's cesium lifetime archive. Its [specific attribution and provenance](3701333/ATTRIBUTION.md) record CC-BY-4.0 terms, the verified source archive and per-file hashes. It is a data-adequacy screen, not a continuation of the first detector model fit.
